summary: The parent reverses the first two supplied random bytes when encoding a v7 UUID. The fix places random_bytes[0]'s low nibble in UUID byte 6 and random_bytes[1] in byte 7, preserving their order. The exact implementation reversal is available, but no detecting upstream test was found at this commit. The fix adds no tests; existing v7 tests and builder doctests check version, variant, timestamp, parsing, or ordering across distinct timestamps, which do not detect this swap. Leave the candidate blocked for lack of a detecting test. No tests were run.
